info.title: Ona Data API (onadata) as deployed by UNICEF Inform
info.description: UNICEF Inform (data.inform.unicef.org) is a deployment of Ona's open-source onadata server, a KoBo/ODK-compatible data-collection platform; Inform serves onadata's own API reference at /static/docs/. This document covers every endpoint in that reference: users, profiles, organizations, teams, projects, forms (publish, versions, exports, imports, sharing, Enketo links), data (submissions, GeoJSON/OSM/CSV renderings, tags, history), submissions and OpenRosa form lists, media and files, metadata, notes, charts, stats, messaging, filtered datasets (DataViews), widgets, merged datasets, REST services, submission reviews, Flow Results packages, Tableau open data and v2 Entities. The OpenFn inform adaptor calls {baseUrl}/api/v1/{forms,data,media,files} with an `Authorization: Token <access_token>` header.

tokenAuth.description: API token: `Authorization: Token <api_token>` (what the adaptor sends).

bearerAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 access token from /o/token/ (Authorization Code + PKCE).

Error.description: DRF error body. Field-validation errors are returned as {field: [messages]}.

Message.description: A message result; in /messaging lists, an event record.

role.description: owner, manager, editor, editor-minor, editor-no-download, dataentry, dataentry-minor, dataentry-only, readonly or readonly-no-download.

remove.description: v2 PUT/PATCH: true removes the member.

role.description: readonly, dataentry, editor, manager (owner for projects).

Submission.description: A submission. Underscore-prefixed keys are metadata; every other key is a form field (group paths joined with /).

SubmissionReceipt.description: Submission acknowledgement; its fields are not documented (XML submissions receive an OpenRosa response).

submission.description: Answers keyed by field name; meta/instanceID optional.

data_type.description: e.g. media, source, supporting_doc, data_license, enketo_url, external_export, textit, google_sheets.

FieldStats.description: Statistics keyed by field name (each a map of method -> value).

name.description: Service type: generic_json, generic_xml, textit, google_sheets, ...

EntityList.description: An EntityList. The list endpoint's example spells counts and dates without underscores (datecreated, numentities); the detail endpoint uses the underscored names modelled here.
